newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan sets date for 50,000 tonnes sugar bids.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan sets date for 50,000 tonnes sugar bids.

text.p: The state-run Trading Corporation of Pakistan (TCP) said on Wednesday it would open bids on Saturday, December 7, for the import of 50,000 tonnes of white refined sugar for shipment by December 31.
The government called the tender because of a sluggish start to domestic sugarcane crushing. The crushing season normally starts in October, but began in November this year.
The TCP and private importers had bought more than 425,000 tonnes of sugar before the start of the crushing season.
